title: 衣索比亞復興大壩
summary: 衣索比亞復興大壩位於青尼羅河上，主壩是高約 145 m 的碾壓混凝土重力壩，水庫容量約 740 億 m³、裝置容量約 5,150 MW；課程定量分析機組出力與容量因數、創紀錄的碾壓混凝土澆築、混凝土面板堆石鞍部壩，以及水庫初次蓄水對下游流量的影響。
summaryEn: The Grand Ethiopian Renaissance Dam on the Blue Nile has an RCC gravity main dam about 145 m high, a reservoir of about 74 km³ and about 5,150 MW installed; the course quantifies unit output and capacity factor, record-setting RCC placement, the concrete-faced rockfill saddle dam, and the effect of first filling on downstream flow.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與標準架構編寫的原創教學。步驟是可驗證的分析、估算與檢核任務，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、運轉程序或作業許可。核能內容僅限公開的熱循環、功能架構、土木與安全理念，不包含燃料製備、濃縮、再處理、武器、反應度整定、反應爐操作或保安細節。數值為公開標稱值或教學假設，實際工程須由合格專業人員依規範與實測資料重新計算並負責。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and standards frameworks. Steps are verifiable analysis, estimation and checking tasks, not drawings, method statements, operating procedures or permits. Nuclear content is limited to public thermal cycles, functional architecture, civil works and safety concepts and excludes fuel production, enrichment, reprocessing, weapons, reactivity settings, reactor operation and security details. Numbers are public nominal values or teaching assumptions; real work must be recalculated by qualified professionals using codes and measured data.
v30Focus: 千萬方級碾壓混凝土壩、五公里鞍部壩與跨國水庫初次蓄水
v30FocusEn: A ten-million-cubic-metre RCC dam, a five-kilometre saddle dam and first filling of a transboundary reservoir

stages.title: 資源、需求與系統架構：衣索比亞復興大壩
stages.titleEn: Resource, demand and system architecture: Grand Ethiopian Renaissance Dam
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「水頭、流量與出力」與「水庫初次蓄水與下游流量」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Head, discharge and output" and "First filling and downstream flow": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

quiz.question: 關於「水頭、流量與出力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Head, discharge and output" is correct?
options: 水輪機把水的位能轉成軸功：每秒通過的水量乘上有效落差，再扣掉水道、水輪機與發電機的損失，就是電氣出力。
壩越高，每一台機組的出力就一定越大。
水庫蓄水只是把水暫時存起來，下游的總水量不會改變。
optionsEn: A hydraulic turbine converts the potential energy of water into shaft work: the water passing each second times the effective drop, less waterway, turbine and generator losses, is the electrical output.
The higher the dam, the larger the output of every unit must be.
Filling a reservoir only stores water temporarily, so the total reaching downstream is unchanged.
quiz.explanation: 水輪機把水的位能轉成軸功：每秒通過的水量乘上有效落差，再扣掉水道、水輪機與發電機的損失，就是電氣出力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A hydraulic turbine converts the potential energy of water into shaft work: the water passing each second times the effective drop, less waterway, turbine and generator losses, is the electrical output. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 水頭、流量與出力：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Head, discharge and output: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「水頭、流量與出力」如何決定「衣索比亞復興大壩」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Head, discharge and output” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Grand Ethiopian Renaissance Dam”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 水輪機把水的位能轉成軸功：每秒通過的水量乘上有效落差，再扣掉水道、水輪機與發電機的損失，就是電氣出力。毛水頭是上下游水位差，淨水頭還要扣除攔污柵、進水口、壓力鋼管與尾水管的水頭損失，因此同一台機組在豐水與枯水期的出力與效率並不相同。以「衣索比亞復興大壩」為例，額定水頭與額定流量是機組選型的起點，其餘尺寸、轉速與空蝕餘裕都由這兩個量推導。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A hydraulic turbine converts the potential energy of water into shaft work: the water passing each second times the effective drop, less waterway, turbine and generator losses, is the electrical output. Gross head is the level difference between headwater and tailwater; net head also deducts losses at the trash rack, intake, penstock and draft tube, so the same unit has different output and efficiency in wet and dry seasons. For Grand Ethiopian Renaissance Dam, rated head and rated discharge are the starting point of unit selection; runner size, speed and cavitation margin all follow from them. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：主壩為碾壓混凝土重力壩，高約 145 m、長約 1,780 m
steps.observationEn: Project file: The main dam is an RCC gravity structure about 145 m high and about 1,780 m long
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「壩越高，每一台機組的出力就一定越大。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The higher the dam, the larger the output of every unit must be." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「水頭、流量與出力」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The flow diagram shows inputs, conversions, losses and boundary for “Head, discharge and output”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 水頭、流量與出力
knowledge.text: 水輪機把水的位能轉成軸功：每秒通過的水量乘上有效落差，再扣掉水道、水輪機與發電機的損失，就是電氣出力。毛水頭是上下游水位差，淨水頭還要扣除攔污柵、進水口、壓力鋼管與尾水管的水頭損失，因此同一台機組在豐水與枯水期的出力與效率並不相同。以「衣索比亞復興大壩」為例，額定水頭與額定流量是機組選型的起點，其餘尺寸、轉速與空蝕餘裕都由這兩個量推導。
knowledge.textEn: A hydraulic turbine converts the potential energy of water into shaft work: the water passing each second times the effective drop, less waterway, turbine and generator losses, is the electrical output. Gross head is the level difference between headwater and tailwater; net head also deducts losses at the trash rack, intake, penstock and draft tube, so the same unit has different output and efficiency in wet and dry seasons. For Grand Ethiopian Renaissance Dam, rated head and rated discharge are the starting point of unit selection; runner size, speed and cavitation margin all follow from them.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：壩越高，每一台機組的出力就一定越大。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The higher the dam, the larger the output of every unit must be. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 工程檔案
knowledge.text: 主壩為碾壓混凝土重力壩，高約 145 m、長約 1,780 m
knowledge.textEn: The main dam is an RCC gravity structure about 145 m high and about 1,780 m long

quiz.question: 依「水頭、流量與出力」的模型 P = ρ·g·Q·H·η，額定工況的單機電氣出力最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model P = ρ·g·Q·H·η for "Head, discharge and output", which value is closest to the electrical output of one unit at rated conditions?
options: 200 MW
401 MW
optionsEn: 200 MW
401 MW
quiz.explanation: P = ρ·g·Q·H·η；代入 ρ = 1000、g = 9.81、Q = 343 m³/s、H = 128 m、η = 0.93，得 401 MW（額定工況的單機電氣出力）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: P = ρ·g·Q·H·η; with ρ = 1000, g = 9.81, Q = 343 m³/s, H = 128 m, η = 0.93 the result is 401 MW (electrical output of one unit at rated conditions). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 水頭、流量與出力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Head, discharge and output: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「水頭、流量與出力」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Head, discharge and output” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：P = ρ·g·Q·H·η；代入 ρ = 1000、g = 9.81、Q = 343 m³/s、H = 128 m、η = 0.93，得 401 MW（額定工況的單機電氣出力）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 H 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: P = ρ·g·Q·H·η; with ρ = 1000, g = 9.81, Q = 343 m³/s, H = 128 m, η = 0.93 the result is 401 MW (electrical output of one unit at rated conditions). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise H by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：H 增加 10% 時，結果變為 441 MW（+10.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising H by 10% changes the result to 441 MW (+10.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 401 MW（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 H 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 401 MW (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in H with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: P = ρ·g·Q·H·η；代入 ρ = 1000、g = 9.81、Q = 343 m³/s、H = 128 m、η = 0.93，得 401 MW（額定工況的單機電氣出力）。
knowledge.textEn: P = ρ·g·Q·H·η; with ρ = 1000, g = 9.81, Q = 343 m³/s, H = 128 m, η = 0.93 the result is 401 MW (electrical output of one unit at rated conditions).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: H 增加 10% 時，結果變為 441 MW（+10.0%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising H by 10% changes the result to 441 MW (+10.0%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「水頭、流量與出力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Head, discharge and output"?
options: 量測時不必記錄環境溫度、負載與運轉模式，因為它們不影響結果。
副壩比主壩矮很多，所以不是安全上的重點。
以 IEC 60041 的現場效率試驗核對：用壓力—時間法、超音波時差法或指數法量流量，以壓力傳感器與水位計求淨水頭，以電力分析儀量發電機出力，在多個導葉開度下畫出效率曲線，與模型試驗換算值比較並標示不確定度。
optionsEn: Ambient temperature, load and operating mode need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
The saddle dam is much lower than the main dam, so it is not a safety concern.

Check it with an IEC 60041 field efficiency test: measure discharge by the pressure-time, acoustic transit-time or index method, derive net head from pressure transducers and level gauges, measure generator output with a power analyser, and plot efficiency at several guide-vane openings against the scaled model-test curve with stated uncertainty.
quiz.explanation: 以 IEC 60041 的現場效率試驗核對：用壓力—時間法、超音波時差法或指數法量流量，以壓力傳感器與水位計求淨水頭，以電力分析儀量發電機出力，在多個導葉開度下畫出效率曲線，與模型試驗換算值比較並標示不確定度。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check it with an IEC 60041 field efficiency test: measure discharge by the pressure-time, acoustic transit-time or index method, derive net head from pressure transducers and level gauges, measure generator output with a power analyser, and plot efficiency at several guide-vane openings against the scaled model-test curve with stated uncertainty. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 水頭、流量與出力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Head, discharge and output: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「水頭、流量與出力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Head, discharge and output” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以 IEC 60041 的現場效率試驗核對：用壓力—時間法、超音波時差法或指數法量流量，以壓力傳感器與水位計求淨水頭，以電力分析儀量發電機出力，在多個導葉開度下畫出效率曲線，與模型試驗換算值比較並標示不確定度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check it with an IEC 60041 field efficiency test: measure discharge by the pressure-time, acoustic transit-time or index method, derive net head from pressure transducers and level gauges, measure generator output with a power analyser, and plot efficiency at several guide-vane openings against the scaled model-test curve with stated uncertainty. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：驗收文件要同時列出毛水頭、各段水頭損失與淨水頭，並註明量測斷面位置；出力保證值必須綁定淨水頭與流量，而不是水庫水位。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Acceptance documents should list gross head, each head-loss component and net head with the measurement sections; guaranteed output must be tied to net head and discharge, not to reservoir level.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若把壩高或毛水頭直接當成淨水頭，計算出力會高於實際；長引水道在大流量時水頭損失隨流量平方上升，機組在滿載時反而達不到額定出力，營運上表現為「水夠卻發不滿」。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using dam height or gross head as net head overstates output; in long waterways the head loss rises with the square of discharge, so the unit cannot reach rated output at full gate and the plant appears to have enough water yet cannot deliver full load. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以 IEC 60041 的現場效率試驗核對：用壓力—時間法、超音波時差法或指數法量流量，以壓力傳感器與水位計求淨水頭，以電力分析儀量發電機出力，在多個導葉開度下畫出效率曲線，與模型試驗換算值比較並標示不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: Check it with an IEC 60041 field efficiency test: measure discharge by the pressure-time, acoustic transit-time or index method, derive net head from pressure transducers and level gauges, measure generator output with a power analyser, and plot efficiency at several guide-vane openings against the scaled model-test curve with stated uncertainty.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 驗收文件要同時列出毛水頭、各段水頭損失與淨水頭，並註明量測斷面位置；出力保證值必須綁定淨水頭與流量，而不是水庫水位。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance documents should list gross head, each head-loss component and net head with the measurement sections; guaranteed output must be tied to net head and discharge, not to reservoir level.

knowledge.title: 規範與標準
knowledge.text: 可對照的公開規範或指引：IEC 60193 水輪機、蓄能泵與水泵水輪機模型驗收試驗。引用時須確認版次與適用範圍。
knowledge.textEn: A public code or guide to compare against: IEC 60193 Hydraulic turbines, storage pumps and pump-turbines – Model acceptance tests. Confirm edition and applicability before citing it.

quiz.question: 在「水頭、流量與出力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Head, discharge and output" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若把壩高或毛水頭直接當成淨水頭，計算出力會高於實際；長引水道在大流量時水頭損失隨流量平方上升，機組在滿載時反而達不到額定出力，營運上表現為「水夠卻發不滿」。
所有異常都是操作人員失誤，設計、製造與維護不需要檢討。
水庫蓄水只是把水暫時存起來，下游的總水量不會改變。
optionsEn: Using dam height or gross head as net head overstates output.
Every anomaly is operator error, so design, manufacturing and maintenance never need review.
Filling a reservoir only stores water temporarily, so the total reaching downstream is unchanged.
quiz.explanation: 若把壩高或毛水頭直接當成淨水頭，計算出力會高於實際；長引水道在大流量時水頭損失隨流量平方上升，機組在滿載時反而達不到額定出力，營運上表現為「水夠卻發不滿」。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using dam height or gross head as net head overstates output; in long waterways the head loss rises with the square of discharge, so the unit cannot reach rated output at full gate and the plant appears to have enough water yet cannot deliver full load. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 水頭、流量與出力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Head, discharge and output: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「水頭、流量與出力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Head, discharge and output” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若把壩高或毛水頭直接當成淨水頭，計算出力會高於實際；長引水道在大流量時水頭損失隨流量平方上升，機組在滿載時反而達不到額定出力，營運上表現為「水夠卻發不滿」。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「衣索比亞復興大壩」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: Using dam height or gross head as net head overstates output; in long waterways the head loss rises with the square of discharge, so the unit cannot reach rated output at full gate and the plant appears to have enough water yet cannot deliver full load. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “Grand Ethiopian Renaissance Dam”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：以「衣索比亞復興大壩」為例，額定水頭與額定流量是機組選型的起點，其餘尺寸、轉速與空蝕餘裕都由這兩個量推導。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: For Grand Ethiopian Renaissance Dam, rated head and rated discharge are the starting point of unit selection; runner size, speed and cavitation margin all follow from them.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「壩越高，每一台機組的出力就一定越大。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The higher the dam, the larger the output of every unit must be." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 關於「水庫初次蓄水與下游流量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "First filling and downstream flow" is correct?
options: 水庫蓄水只是把水暫時存起來，下游的總水量不會改變。
機組在任何負載下運轉都一樣平穩，只是效率不同。
復興大壩水庫的容量超過青尼羅河一整年的水量。
optionsEn: Filling a reservoir only stores water temporarily, so the total reaching downstream is unchanged.
A unit runs equally smoothly at any load; only efficiency differs.
The GERD reservoir holds more than a whole year of Blue Nile flow.
quiz.explanation: 復興大壩水庫的容量超過青尼羅河一整年的水量。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The GERD reservoir holds more than a whole year of Blue Nile flow. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 水庫初次蓄水與下游流量：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: First filling and downstream flow: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「水庫初次蓄水與下游流量」如何決定「衣索比亞復興大壩」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “First filling and downstream flow” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Grand Ethiopian Renaissance Dam”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 復興大壩水庫的容量超過青尼羅河一整年的水量。初次蓄水期間，每年留在水庫裡的水就是下游蘇丹與埃及當年少收到的水；蓄得越快，電廠越早滿載，下游的短期衝擊也越大。衣索比亞採取只在雨季（7 至 8 月）蓄水、分數年完成的方式。這是典型的跨國河流問題：同一個工程參數——每年蓄留量——同時決定上游的效益與下游的風險。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The GERD reservoir holds more than a whole year of Blue Nile flow. During first filling, water retained each year is water that Sudan and Egypt downstream do not receive that year; faster filling brings the plant to full output sooner but increases the short-term impact downstream. Ethiopia filled only in the rainy season, July to August, over several years. This is the classic transboundary river problem: one engineering parameter, the volume retained each year, sets both the upstream benefit and the downstream risk. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：主壩碾壓混凝土約 1,020 萬 m³
steps.observationEn: Project file: The main dam contains about 10.2 million m³ of RCC
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「水庫蓄水只是把水暫時存起來，下游的總水量不會改變。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Filling a reservoir only stores water temporarily, so the total reaching downstream is unchanged." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.

quiz.question: 依「水庫初次蓄水與下游流量」的模型 t = V / (f·W)，每年蓄留年逕流量的 25% 時蓄滿水庫所需年數（年逕流量取 49 km³）最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model t = V / (f·W) for "First filling and downstream flow", which value is closest to the years to fill the reservoir retaining 25% of annual runoff each year (runoff taken as 49 km³)?
optionsEn: 6.0 years
60.4 years
3.02 years
quiz.explanation: t = V / (f·W)；代入 V = 74 km³、f = 0.25、W = 49 km³，得 6.0 年（每年蓄留年逕流量的 25% 時蓄滿水庫所需年數（年逕流量取 49 km³））。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: t = V / (f·W); with V = 74 km³, f = 0.25, W = 49 km³ the result is 6.0 years (years to fill the reservoir retaining 25% of annual runoff each year (runoff taken as 49 km³)). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 水庫初次蓄水與下游流量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: First filling and downstream flow: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「水庫初次蓄水與下游流量」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “First filling and downstream flow” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：t = V / (f·W)；代入 V = 74 km³、f = 0.25、W = 49 km³，得 6.0 年（每年蓄留年逕流量的 25% 時蓄滿水庫所需年數（年逕流量取 49 km³））。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 f 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: t = V / (f·W); with V = 74 km³, f = 0.25, W = 49 km³ the result is 6.0 years (years to fill the reservoir retaining 25% of annual runoff each year (runoff taken as 49 km³)). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise f by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：f 增加 10% 時，結果變為 5.5 年（-9.1%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising f by 10% changes the result to 5.5 years (-9.1%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 6.0 年（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 f 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 6.0 years (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in f with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: t = V / (f·W)；代入 V = 74 km³、f = 0.25、W = 49 km³，得 6.0 年（每年蓄留年逕流量的 25% 時蓄滿水庫所需年數（年逕流量取 49 km³））。
knowledge.textEn: t = V / (f·W); with V = 74 km³, f = 0.25, W = 49 km³ the result is 6.0 years (years to fill the reservoir retaining 25% of annual runoff each year (runoff taken as 49 km³)).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: f 增加 10% 時，結果變為 5.5 年（-9.1%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising f by 10% changes the result to 5.5 years (-9.1%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「水庫初次蓄水與下游流量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "First filling and downstream flow"?
options: 沿用另一座電廠或另一台機組的試驗結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以衛星測高與影像估算水庫水位與面積的變化，並比對壩下與蘇丹邊境水文站的流量，獨立核算每年的蓄留量。
混凝土強度越高、水泥越多，壩體就越安全。
optionsEn: Reusing test results from another plant or unit counts as verifying this project.

Estimate changes in reservoir level and area from satellite altimetry and imagery, compare with flow at gauging stations below the dam and at the Sudanese border, and compute annual retention independently.
Higher strength and more cement always make a dam safer.
quiz.explanation: 以衛星測高與影像估算水庫水位與面積的變化，並比對壩下與蘇丹邊境水文站的流量，獨立核算每年的蓄留量。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Estimate changes in reservoir level and area from satellite altimetry and imagery, compare with flow at gauging stations below the dam and at the Sudanese border, and compute annual retention independently. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 水庫初次蓄水與下游流量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: First filling and downstream flow: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「水庫初次蓄水與下游流量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “First filling and downstream flow” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以衛星測高與影像估算水庫水位與面積的變化，並比對壩下與蘇丹邊境水文站的流量，獨立核算每年的蓄留量。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Estimate changes in reservoir level and area from satellite altimetry and imagery, compare with flow at gauging stations below the dam and at the Sudanese border, and compute annual retention independently. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：跨國河流的蓄水計畫要事先約定乾旱年的放流規則與即時資料交換，並由獨立的量測核實。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Filling plans on transboundary rivers should agree drought-year release rules and real-time data exchange in advance, verified by independent measurement.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若蓄水期恰逢連續乾旱年而上下游又缺乏資料共享，下游水庫水位快速下降，灌溉與發電都受衝擊，並升高為外交爭端。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If filling coincides with consecutive dry years and data are not shared between upstream and downstream, downstream reservoirs fall quickly, irrigation and power suffer, and the matter escalates into a diplomatic dispute. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.
